faq.q: How do I contact a business?
faq.a: Open a business profile and use the phone, WhatsApp or message button to reach them directly.

faq.q: How do I list my business?
faq.a: Click "List your business", create a free account, and complete your profile.

faq.q: Is Service City available in my city?
faq.a: We currently focus on Casablanca and major Moroccan cities, with more added over time.

faq.q: How do I report an issue?
faq.a: Use the in-app support or email our team and we will get back to you as soon as possible.
